name: same_person_wrong_event
description: Benchmark for verifying wrong-event rejection when articles mention the same public figure but cover a different event

seed.description: James Comey indicted on federal charges related to social media post containing seashells arranged as 8647

simulated_candidates.title: James Comey Indicted Over Social Media Post
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: Former FBI Director James Comey was indicted on charges related to a post on X showing seashells arranged to spell 8647.

simulated_candidates.title: Comey's Historic Testimony Before Senate Intelligence Committee
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: Former FBI Director James Comey testified before the Senate Intelligence Committee about his interactions with President Trump in 2017.

simulated_candidates.title: Comey's Memoir Reveals New Details About FBI Leadership
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: A Higher Loyalty by James Comey details his time as FBI Director and the turbulent relationship with the Trump administration.

simulated_candidates.title: Former FBI Chief Comey Faces Federal Charges Over Post
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: James Comey, former head of the FBI, has been indicted in connection with a social media post that prosecutors say contained a threat coded as 8647.

simulated_candidates.title: Revisiting the Day Trump Fired Comey
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: In May 2017, President Trump fired FBI Director James Comey, setting off a political firestorm that would lead to the Mueller investigation.

expectations.description: Articles about the same person (Comey) but different events (2017 firing, testimony, memoir) must be rejected. Only articles about the 2026 indictment/8647 post should survive.
